videos.title: Review possible matches and teach the matcher
videos.summary: Raise an item's sensitivity, leave look-alikes unticked so the app learns what is not that symbol, recount, then tick the real possible matches.

videos.title: Addendum day: add the revised sheet and price the change
videos.summary: Add the addendum as its own set, compare old and new sheets, grey out the legend, copy the runs across, recount, and export the priced adds and omits for your change order. Narrated.

videos.title: Read a legend and count every symbol
videos.summary: Grey out the notes and title block, box the symbol legend, name each symbol and count them all on every sheet in one go.

videos.title: Finish and send a bid: review, check, lock and export
videos.summary: Clear the possible matches, check the bid for gaps, add the client and your markups, lock the bid and export the quote PDF. Narrated.

videos.title: Set the scale on a sheet
videos.summary: Check the scale the app read from the title block, pick another, or calibrate from a known dimension. Then use it on every sheet.

videos.title: Your first electrical bid, start to finish
videos.summary: Open a drawing, set the scale, read the legend, check the ticks, draw a run and export the quote. Narrated.

videos.title: Start a job and add drawings
videos.summary: Open your drawing files, rename the job and add an addendum later. Everything saves as you go.

videos.title: Join sheets at a match line
videos.summary: Line up a floor split over two sheets so runs that cross the line count once.
